$comment: Rules the JSON Schemas can’t express. Generated with the schemas; payload-contract.md §10.

rules.rule: Action ids are unique within a widget, and the built-in ids (answer, submit, cancel, check, set, approve, edit, reject, undo, rate, acknowledge, refresh, retry) are used only for their built-in meaning.
rules.example_error: actions[1].id "approve" is reserved; use another id

rules.rule: At most one action (including a summary’s do_first) is primary.
rules.example_error: two primary actions; make one secondary

rules.rule: A destructive action has confirm; an open action has url; a copy action has value.
rules.example_error: actions[0]: destructive needs confirm

rules.rule: expires_at is after as_of; every end is after its start; stale_after is positive.
rules.example_error: expires_at is before as_of

rules.rule: A percent Quantity or Delta is a fraction (0.12 = 12%). An absolute value over 1.5 is almost always a mistake.
rules.example_error: items[0].delta.value 12 with format percent: send 0.12 for 12%

rules.rule: fallback_text uses absolute dates and times; relative words only beside an absolute one.
rules.example_error: fallback_text says “tomorrow” without a date

rules.rule: fallback_text is ≤ 2,000 characters (≤ 4,000 for a stack); over the cap it ends “… and N more (in the Hermes app)”.
rules.example_error: fallback_text is 2,412 characters

rules.rule: No string matches the gateway’s redaction patterns; masked values (card numbers, phone numbers) show at most 4 digits.
rules.example_error: details.sections[0].fields[3].value looks like a card number

rules.rule: producer is set by the plugin from the session; a bot:<handle> icon names the producer; handoff.from.bot is the producer.
rules.example_error: icon bot:scout on a widget from Hermes

rules.rule: In a group session: no private widgets; approval, control and form need for; only the producer may update.
rules.example_error: private widget in a group chat

rules.rule: icon and symbol fields name an SF Symbol from the allowlist (payload-contract.md §7) or bot:<handle>.
rules.example_error: icon “rocket.fill” isn’t in the allowlist; drawn as the default glyph

rules.rule: At most three directives per reply (a stack counts as one); each id was created or delivered in this chat.
rules.example_error: four widgets in one reply; use a stack

rules.rule: Item, option, field, node, step and card ids are unique within their list.
rules.example_error: items[4].id “tomatoes” is used twice

rules.rule: Every series has one value per x value; callout.x is one of the x values; x values parse in their format.
rules.example_error: series[1] has 13 values for 14 x values

rules.rule: With kind safety, there is one criterion per item the person declared (each allergen asked about).
rules.example_error: Maya avoids peanuts, tree nuts and sesame; criteria cover 2 of 3

rules.rule: Zones are ordered and don’t overlap; target lies within min–max.
rules.example_error: zones overlap at 70–75

rules.rule: Every mark’s date lies within start–end; one mark per date.
rules.example_error: mark 2026-11-02 is outside 21 Sep – 18 Oct

rules.rule: A group’s count equals its number of rows (or says “of N” when rows are cut).
rules.example_error: groups[1].count 3 but 2 rows

rules.rule: Every row’s keys are column keys; the total row covers numeric columns only.
rules.example_error: rows[2] has key “chang” that isn’t a column

rules.rule: At most one field has emphasis.
rules.example_error: two emphasised fields

rules.rule: At most 60 nodes in all, 4 levels deep.
rules.example_error: outline has 74 nodes

rules.rule: rating.value ≤ rating.scale.
rules.example_error: rating 6 on a scale of 5

rules.rule: Audio isn’t mixed with images or video in one widget.
rules.example_error: items mix audio and images

rules.rule: range.end ≥ range.start, and the range fits the file.
rules.example_error: range 40–12

rules.rule: Pipeline step titles are ≤ 16 characters (longer ones make the client draw the vertical layout).
rules.example_error: pipeline title “Run the integration tests” is 25 characters

rules.rule: fix appears only on warning or critical items.
rules.example_error: items[0] is ok but has fix

rules.rule: At most one recommended option; preselected only with select many; times options are in time order.
rules.example_error: two recommended options

rules.rule: No field asks for a password, PIN, key or card number (Hermes has its own secret request).
rules.example_error: field “API key” asks for a secret

rules.rule: expires_at is after as_of and, for purchases, before the moment the purchase stops being possible.
rules.example_error: expires_at 11:45 is after the 11:40 cancellation window

rules.rule: A point’s emphasis is the start of its text.
rules.example_error: points[2].emphasis isn’t the start of its text

rules.rule: start_at names one of the steps (an unknown id opens at step 1).
rules.example_error: start_at “prep” isn’t a step

rules.rule: values and scores are keyed by option ids; pick is an option id and, with adjustable, the top weighted total.
rules.example_error: criteria[1].values has key “bose” that isn’t an option

rules.rule: Each child validates against its own type schema; ids are unique; sections name existing children in order; a carousel holds one type; any private child makes the stack private.
rules.example_error: children[2] (agenda): events[0].start is required
